Just outside New York City, Fairfield County, Connecticut, is home to some of the wealthiest suburbs in America. But just down the road is Bridgeport, an old manufacturing city that followed a very different path. Today, we travel across the county, meet the locals, and see how these two very different worlds exist side by side.
